description: A React component for the 'Explore' page of a career navigator web app. It handles search, filters, and displays either role recommendations or a mindmap view based on user interaction.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, defaulting to empty string if null or undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Ensures input is an array of strings, normalizing each string and filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range from role object into min and max values in lakhs.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a role object, handling different possible property names.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a role object matches the current filter criteria including industry, skills, salary, and title query.

methods.name: ExploreClient
methods.description: Main React component for the explore page, managing state, fetching data, and rendering UI elements with filtering and search functionality.
